scope: Real ASL alphabet examples with traceable physical-hand, illumination and camera-view annotations; no language substitution or generated diversity

sources.name: MU HandImages ASL (Massey)
sources.verified: Original paper sections 3/4 document capture lamps and source filename illumination codes; section 7 resolves redistribution terms.
sources.missing: Physical left/right labels, per-image camera angles, illuminance values and sessions. Camera setup is documented only at protocol level.
sources.action: Bundle 895 hash-verified coordinate records with per-sample light-direction evidence; reserve outside training.

sources.name: ASLLVD
sources.verified: Source video protocol identifies frontal and signer-right profile cameras and right-hand-dominant consultants. Existing J/Z tokens are source-labeled one-hand productions.
sources.missing: Verified left-hand alphabet tokens and physical per-recording illumination. Brightness normalization is a postprocessing fact.
sources.action: Evaluate paired source camera views of existing recordings; keep restricted clips/coordinates local; count each recording once.

sources.name: SignAlphaSet V3
sources.verified: Publisher reports both hands and describes controlled lighting.
sources.missing: Paper explicitly says randomized filenames do not distinguish physical hand. Archive provides no hand, camera-angle or illumination annotation table; static augmentation status is not encoded.
sources.action: Do not convert detector handedness, global percentages or image brightness into verified per-image capture labels.

sources.name: ASL-HG
sources.verified: P1-P10 source signer IDs and letter labels.
sources.missing: Per-image physical hand, lighting, angle and session. Described indoor/outdoor diversity does not identify those conditions in individual files.
sources.action: Retain existing training data and preserve unknown fields.

sources.name: ASLYset
sources.verified: Publisher states original images use the right hand.
sources.missing: Physical left-hand examples and per-image lighting/view labels.
sources.action: Do not count geometric mirroring as real left-hand collection.

sources.name: NVIDIA ASL 1000
sources.verified: Registry describes human-corrected landmark annotations and explicitly lists a controlled-access link.
sources.missing: Access approval and inspected sample-level alphabet/lighting/view metadata.
sources.action: Do not bypass access controls or claim uninspected annotations.

sources.name: Google ASL Fingerspelling Recognition Corpus
sources.verified: Phrase labels and source participant IDs; source card says some signers switched hands between clips.
sources.missing: Verified per-clip physical hand and lighting/view metadata; isolated character boundaries. Left/right landmark blocks are generated by MediaPipe.
sources.action: Do not infer actual signing hand from participant dominance or automatically segment phrase labels into verified alphabet clips.

sources.name: ChicagoFSWild
sources.verified: Human sequence transcription, signer ID and hand-box labels for signing/non-signing roles.
sources.missing: The published schema does not provide per-recording illumination and camera-angle labels; a box role is not physical handedness.
sources.action: Do not count fingerspelled word transcripts as independently annotated character samples.

sources.name: Pugeault/Bowden ASL Finger Spelling
sources.verified: Dataset A groups static ASL letters by five source subjects under similar lighting/background; dataset B describes two environments.
sources.missing: Physical-hand/per-image-angle annotation table; the harder lighting dataset is depth-only.
sources.action: Do not treat depth-only condition diversity as RGB webcam evidence.

sources.name: OpenSign
sources.verified: Public record describes ASL letter/digit examples and provides a sample video.
sources.missing: The complete annotated dataset is supplied by contacting the author, not the public record; needed condition annotations have not been inspected.
sources.action: No contact was sent and no unpublished annotation coverage is claimed.

sources.name: ASLA surface-EMG alphabet corpus
sources.verified: Source participant IDs encode left/right hand.
sources.missing: Optical alphabet images, lighting and camera-view data; source requires a signed access form.
sources.action: Do not count EMG hand labels as webcam image coverage.

sources.name: Mexican Sign Language dynamic alphabet
sources.verified: Source filenames encode participant, letter, view and repetition.
sources.missing: ASL labels; this is LSM, with its own alphabet conventions.
sources.action: Do not relabel LSM samples as ASL.

sources.name: Sign4all
sources.verified: Primary paper documents left/right-hand examples in Spanish Sign Language.
sources.action: Do not use matching Latin letters as proof of ASL equivalence.
